sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Patsy David,Sagar Mehrotra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State and perused the record of the case.

2. This Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been moved by the applicants directly before this Court seeking Anticipatory Bail in Case Crime No.54 of 2023,
under Sections 420, 467, 468, 506, 120-B I.P.C. & 3/5(1) of U.P. Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act, 2021, Police Station Kotwali, District Fatehpur, during pendency of investigation.
3.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants have approached the Apex Court by filing Special Leave to Appeal (Crl) Nos.15251-15254/2003 (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 28.08.2023 in CRLMWP No.13610/2023 28.08.2023 in CRLMWP Prem Nath And Another vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62025777/
1 No.13566/2023 28.08.2023 in CRLMWP No.13597/2023 28.08.2023 in CRLMWP No.13577/2023 passed by the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad). The Apex Court by order dated 04.12.2023 issue notice to the respondents and passed the following orders:-
"1. Issue notice.
2. Tag with SLPO (CRl) No.3210 of 2023.
3. Pending further orders, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners in connection with Case Crime Nos.224 of 2022, 47 of 2023, 54 of 2023, 55 of 2023, 60 of 2023, 563 of 2023, 576 of 2023, 579 of 2023 and 581 of 2023, registered at PS Kotwali, District Fatehpur, U.P."
4.
